question: Can government employees be exempted from the CPCT exam after turning 40?
answer: No. GAD has made no provision for CPCT exemption; orders that ended probation by granting such an exemption are to be cancelled and action taken against the officers concerned.

question: क्या 40 वर्ष की आयु पूरी होने पर सीपीसीटी परीक्षा से छूट मिलती है?
answer: नहीं। सीपीसीटी से छूट का कोई प्रावधान नहीं है; ऐसी छूट देकर किए गए नियमितीकरण के आदेश निरस्त किए जाएँ।

question: Hindi typing test aur CPCT mein kya fark hai, dono ki chhoot same hai kya?
answer: Dono alag pariksha hain. 1984 aur 1992 ke circular sirf Hindi typing test ki chhoot ke baare mein the, CPCT (computer proficiency) pe lagu nahi hote.

question: How many iGOT Karmayogi courses must employees complete in a financial year?
answer: At least 6 of the prescribed courses (out of 15 listed) every financial year.

question: आईगॉट कर्मयोगी पोर्टल पर प्रशिक्षण में कठिनाई हो तो किससे संपर्क करें?
answer: श्री अब्दुल आसिफ, कंसल्टेंट, एम.पी.एस.ई.डी.सी. (सा.प्र.वि. शाखा 09)।

question: karmayogi portal pe kitne course karna zaroori hai sarkari karmchariyon ko?
answer: Har financial year mein kam se kam 6 course.

question: What is the revised dearness allowance rate for All India Services officers from January 2026?
answer: 60% of basic pay per month, up from 58%, effective 1 January 2026.

question: अखिल भारतीय सेवा के अधिकारियों का महंगाई भत्ता कितने प्रतिशत से बढ़ाकर कितना किया गया?
IAS officers ka DA kitna badha hai aur kab se milega?
answer: 58% se 60%, 1 January 2026 se, nagad bhugtan.

question: Under the 2026 transfer policy, can an employee be transferred during the ban period because of serious illness?
answer: Yes, as an exception, for urgent need arising from serious illness such as cancer, paralysis or heart attack, with the departmental minister's approval.

question: Which women employees can be transferred to their home district?
answer: Unmarried, widowed, divorced or abandoned women; otherwise executive staff are generally not posted in their home district.

question: जिन कर्मचारियों की सेवानिवृत्ति में एक वर्ष से कम समय बचा हो, क्या उनका स्थानांतरण होगा?
answer: सामान्यतः नहीं। सेवानिवृत्ति में एक वर्ष या कम समय शेष होने पर स्थानांतरण नहीं किया जाए।

question: अनुसूचित क्षेत्रों में कितने वर्ष की सेवा पूरी करने पर स्थानांतरण किया जाएगा?
answer: 3 वर्ष की सेवा पूर्ण करने पर।

question: pati patni ko ek hi jagah posting ke liye transfer policy mein kya rule hai?
answer: Swayam ke vyay pe aavedan dene par transfer ho sakta hai; jagah prashaskiya avashyakta se tay hogi. Aise transfer vibhag ke nirdharit pratishat ke atirikt hote hain.

question: 40 pratishat se zyada divyang karmchari ka transfer ho sakta hai kya?
answer: Samanyatah nahi kiya jata, lekin wo khud ke kharch pe swechha se aavedan de toh vichar ho sakta hai.

question: Should the disability certificates of all disabled government employees be re-verified?
answer: No. Per the NHRC direction, re-verification only in suspicious or specific cases, under the RPwD Act 2016; no blanket re-verification.

question: दिव्यांगता प्रमाण-पत्रों का पुनः सत्यापन किस अधिनियम के प्रावधानों के अंतर्गत किया जाएगा?
answer: RPwD Act, 2016 (दिव्यांगजन अधिकार अधिनियम) की धाराओं के अंतर्गत, केवल संदिग्ध प्रकरणों में।

question: UDID card aur divyang certificate dobara check karne ke baare mein manav adhikar aayog ne kya kaha hai?
answer: Sabka blanket re-verification galat hai, sirf sandigdh cases mein ho; UDID card banane ki prakriya tez karne ko kaha gaya.

question: What is the theme of International Yoga Day 2026?
answer: Yoga for Healthy Ageing (स्वस्थ आयु के लिए योग).

question: योग दिवस पर सामान्य योग प्रोटोकॉल का अभ्यास किस समय होगा?
yoga day pe sabko kitne baje tak pahunchna hai?
answer: Subah 6:00 baje se pehle.

question: Why was the state-level task force committee formed in August 2026?
answer: To comply with the National Green Tribunal's order dated 10/04/2026 in case 166/2025 (CZ).

question: राज्य स्तरीय टास्कफोर्स समिति की पहली बैठक कब तक होनी है?
answer: 3 माह के अंदर; उसके बाद त्रैमासिक बैठकों से निगरानी।

question: task force samiti ka adhyaksh kaun hai aur kaunse vibhag ke sachiv hain?
answer: Paryavaran vibhag ke bharsadhak sachiv adhyaksh/samanvayak hain.
